headline: Tencent's HY4 Preview Explodes to #1 with 11.7% Share
summary: Tencent/hy4-preview-20260827 rocketed 9 spots in a single day to claim the top position with a record 11.7% token share—the highest any model has ever captured on OpenRouter. The surge pushed Tencent's provider share to 16.9%, up 8.2 points overnight. DeepSeek held steady at #2 (10.4%), while Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3-flash climbed to #3 (10.0%), and OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Luna slipped to #4 (8.5%).
